The CARE Method

A simple framework for the hard moments.

Behavior is communication. The CARE Method helps you respond to what your child is really telling you, before correcting what you see.

C

Connect Before Correct

Connection creates emotional safety. Children learn best when they feel safe and supported, through a calm tone, patience, and your steady presence.

A

Assess the Need

Every behavior has a reason. Sensory overload, fatigue, or trouble communicating often sit underneath. Understanding the cause is how you find the right support.

R

Regulate the Nervous System

A dysregulated nervous system cannot learn. We lower the demands and the sensory load first, so calm can return before any teaching or correcting begins.

E

Empower Through Structure

Structure creates predictability, and predictability creates safety. Visual schedules and steady routines build independence and confidence over time.

Meet Carra

Hi, I am Carra.

My work is personal. It began with my nonverbal niece and grew into a calling to bring compassionate, individualized care to the autism community.

What makes my approach different is that it is holistic. I do not only support the child, I support the whole family system around them. My background includes training as a Registered Behavior Technician, work as a Special Education Aide, and Early Childhood Education studies focused on children with special needs. I have also been a toddler teacher, nanny, and caregiver, which gave me a heartfelt understanding of how children grow, feel, and connect.

I provide coaching, education, in-home support, and respite, not clinical ABA therapy. Through Autism Care with Carra, I bridge understanding, share hands-on strategies, and guide families and educators with warmth, patience, and purpose.
